item.title: America has lost 200k of jobs in media, film and the arts. How much is AI?
item.description:
📝 America has lost more than 200k jobs in “creative” industries over the last four years, with roughly 50k lost within the last year alone. Overall, nearly half the media job losses of the last four years have been concentrated in the movie & sound recording sector that includes Hollywood. The most anticipated albums were often leaked online even before they were on store shelves.
🔗 Read more: https://www.apricitas.io/p/ai-and-the-fall-of-the-creative-class

item.title: Meta employees say Lula’s accounts restricted in Brazil election: Report
item.description:
📝 ListenListen (2 mins)SaveShare Meta employees say Lula’s accounts restricted in Brazil election: Report on social mediashare-nodesSharefacebookxwhatsapp-strokecopylinkgoogleAdd Al Jazeera on GoogleinfoBrazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva will face challenger Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in a presidential election runoff on October 25 [File: Evaristo Sa/AFP]By AP and ReutersPublished On 16 Oct 202616 Oct 2026Employees at Meta have acknowledged in internal communications that the Instagram accounts of Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva were negatively affected by restrictions during the country’s election, media reports say. “Any suggestion that Meta favors one side is false,” it added in a statement. Justice Marco Aurelio Bellizze ruled that Meta cannot reduce the distribution of political content, restrict searches or remove posts in a way that creates an imbalance between Lula and Bolsonaro.
🔗 Read more: https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/10/16/meta-employees-say-lulas-accounts-restricted-in-brazil-election-report
